backend: BackendMbedTls (PSA Crypto, mbedTLS 4.1.0 of ESP-IDF 6.0.2) with CONFIG_MBEDTLS_HARDWARE_ECDSA_VERIFY; 747 checks = 873 host checks minus the OpenSSL-only oracle tests
capture: listen-only after the esptool post-flash reset
verifies: receive-side verification (test_verification), the IEEE Std 1609.2 clause 5.1.2 chain consistency (test_chain_consistency) and the clause 6.4.17 region consistency under an identifiedRegion root (test_region_consistency) on the device; verification cost line: certificate-signed 35.5 ms, digest-signed 35.1 ms end to end, raw ECDSA P-256 verify 29.8 ms on the ECDSA peripheral
note: the same checks appended to test_verification failed on the device only: with a fourth receiver trust configuration the heap was too fragmented (largest free block 16 kB) and an allocation failure inside verify() surfaced as INCOMPATIBLE_PROTOCOL through the catch-all; the chain and region scenarios therefore run as their own tests with a fresh heap and at most two stations alive
